description: Update a key result, including recording a new READING — send current as { value, asOf, source }. Always cite a source: a measure with no source fails delivery condition 2, which is what stops one number being quoted two ways. Requires `write` scope.

current.description: The new reading: { value, asOf, source }. Ignored on a derived measure, which is recomputed on every read.

objectiveId.description: Move it under a different objective.

name: anyforge_update_key_result
title: Update key result
